policy.inline: Only attached native FingeringEvent.digit values are inline anchors; layout numbers are excluded.
policy.markup: Single digits and two-digit substitutions on one note constrain the initial finger; full sequences and source markup remain unchanged.
policy.ornaments: Longer finger runs are retained as ornament metadata rather than relabeled as held-note anchors.
policy.chords: Single supplementary digits map only to one unassigned member; explicit vertical columns map top-to-bottom to descending pitches; unresolved markup remains explicit metadata.
policy.indexing: Inline/markup details and source_annotations.note refer to source chord order; midi_pitches/original_fingers are sorted together for engine comparison. Source-order arrays are retained explicitly.
